title: Support Gaza Journalist Huda Skaik's Journey to University of London
author: Ryan Grim
content:
About a year and a half ago, we launched a fundraising campaign to help a
Pakistani student, Areeba Fatima, cover expenses for the journalism program
she'd been accepted into at Columbia University. This summer, she walked
across the stage a graduate, and along the way, produced some terrific
reporting for Drop Site, including this investigation into state violence in
Kashmir or her recent story on fellow Columbia student Mahmoud Khalil's new
lawsuit against Columbia itself.

All of that was thanks to the generosity of Drop Site readers. Areeba's
success, and your generosity, emboldened us to try it again.

We now have a new opportunity we wanted to get in front of you. [Huda Skaik is
a young Palestinian journalist ](https://givebutter.com/HudaSkaik)from Gaza
and a Drop Site contributor. She has been accepted to the University of
London, where she wants to sharpen her already formidable journalistic skills.
Everything is approved, but for the final visa she needs to raise money to
cover her funding gap--unfortunately by this coming Wednesday.

[Drop Site is launching a campaign to raise the remaining $50,000
](https://givebutter.com/HudaSkaik)she needs by September 23 to support Huda's
journey from Gaza to the University of London.

[Donate to support Huda](https://givebutter.com/HudaSkaik)

Full funding for Huda's remaining two years of study and living costs has to
be secured to meet the financial requirements of the UK visa process. And
she's on a hard deadline. Between the costs the scholarship doesn't cover,
accommodation and living expenses, her visa, and her evacuation and travel out
of Gaza, the total comes to about $116,000. We've raised part of it, but we
still need to raise the remaining **$50,000 by Wednesday, September 23.**

**I think we can do it. If 2,000 people reading this email give $25 each, we
'll hit the target by the end of the afternoon. **(Double-check my math, but I
think that's right.) 100% of the contributions will go toward her scholarship
and we will of course cover the processing fees and all that on our end.)

If you'd like to make a larger gift to help close the gap, please reach out to
**majorgiving@dropsitenews.com** or**ryan@dropsitenews.com** and we can let
you know how to earmark it directly to Huda.

post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb0b792f1-a9ae-40fc-

post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb0b792f1-a9ae-40fc-
bfaa-48177245d461_1600x900.jpeg)Huda Skaik, 21, reporting from Gaza

Alongside video reports and documentaries, Huda has published more than 70
articles at outlets around the world, including The Nation, Al Jazeera, and
Middle East Eye.

Huda earned an "unconditional scholarship" offer to study journalism at the
London university, entering directly into her second year. Her passport is
ready. The university recognized both her academic record and the exceptional
circumstances she's working under.

That's where you come in.

Currently displaced and living under extraordinarily difficult conditions,
Huda remains committed to her work, sharing her vital perspective on the
genocide in Gaza with the world. We're asking you to chip in whatever you can.
$5, $20, $100--it all adds up. If enough of us pitch in, we can make this
happen for Huda.

[Donate to support Huda](https://givebutter.com/HudaSkaik)

"I am not asking for help simply to attend university. I am asking for the
chance to continue telling stories, studying journalism, and using my work to
make sure the experiences of people in Gaza are heard." \- Huda Skaik

[Every dollar you give goes directly toward Huda's evacuation, education, and
living costs.](https://givebutter.com/HudaSkaik) If you can't support
directly, please consider sharing Huda's fundraising page with others in your
network.

Let's do this together,

Ryan and the Drop Site team
